I've completed the Phase 4 review and written the result to `docs/implementation/edition-rebuild-and-rodmachen-home/results/review.json`.

## Summary

**No blocking issues.** The rebuild is well-executed: CI green, 34/34 tests passing, draft filtering applied at all 8 `getCollection('posts')` sites, centralized/consistent singular→plural redirects, clean single-h1 structure on every page type, and FOUC-free theming with proper focus/skip/reduced-motion a11y. No build breakage, broken internal links, shipped drafts, or security exposure.

**9 non-blocking findings**, in priority order:

1. **Redirect trailing-slash asymmetry (highest value, SEO)** — the new `/article`, `/review`, `/essay`, `/byline` rules omit the trailing-slash variant that the pre-existing `/categories` rules deliberately include. Under `trailingSlash: 'always'`, canonical old URLs (`/article/foo/`) redirect via a chain at best, or miss at worst. Worth confirming against the deferred post-merge curl.
2. **Accent token divergence** — `slugs.ts` CATEGORY_CONFIG article/review accents (`#b8654a`/`#9a7b32`) don't match the AA-corrected global.css tokens (`#9c4d34`/`#7a6122`), despite a comment claiming they do. Surfaces on placeholder tiles; also not theme-aware.
3. **PostCardList/PostList not migrated** — Archive/Bylines/Topics list bodies retain pre-rebuild rounded-card styling instead of the broadsheet idiom Rod asked them to share.
4. **Vestigial `essay`** in the `template` enum (Step 4 said drop it).
5. Section indexes share the generic meta description (newsletter SEO miss).
6. rodmachen.com `<h1>` accessible name is "RodMachen" (no separator).
7. Hub labels the site "The Edition" — contradicts the confirmed "Edition" name.
8. CI double-runs on PR branches (`on: push` unfiltered + `pull_request`).
9. No `robots.txt` advertising the new sitemap.

I verified findings against the live source (not just the diff): ran the test suite, confirmed `template` falls back to category so recategorized posts get the right accent, checked all draft-filter sites, traced the `CATEGORY_CONFIG.accent` consumer, and confirmed no stale singular-path links remain. I excluded the deliberately-deferred items per the scope notes.
